title: Worst-Case and Covariance-Reconstruction Robust Adaptive Beamforming: Equivalence and Closed-Form Solution
summary: Robust adaptive beamforming (RAB) has developed along two separate lines. The worst-case-constrained approach guards against steering vector mismatch with a bounded uncertainty set, but suffers from desired signal cancellation at high input signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The covariance-reconstruction approach instead estimates the interference-plus-noise covariance matrix and solves for the mismatch numerically.
